{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the data type of 'revenue'
print("Revenue dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)

# Inspect the first few values of 'revenue' to see if they are strings
print("First 10 revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values after conversion
non_numeric_count = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

print(f"Number of non-numeric revenue entries: {non_numeric_count}")

# Now filter for completed orders and compute mean on the numeric column
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
